title: No stated bound exists on how long one write transaction may hold the exclusive writer lock
outcome: Engram has no declared limit on the duration of a single write transaction, so nothing tells a future change how much writer-lock hold time is acceptable. Record a decision: either a declared bound with enforcement, or an explicit statement that none is intended and what callers may assume instead.
acceptance: the decision is written into the architecture or feature docs and cross-linked from the work-plan brief, so a later change to any plan or decomposition limit has a stated criterion instead of an inherited number
disposal_reason: Decision NO (2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous): no documented writer-lock wall-clock budget governing plan limits; bounded inputs, graph complexity and measured contention diagnostics remain the contract, and scheduling-dependent elapsed time is not a correctness promise.
